text:
Maya Patel: Quick design check for compare table export + pin behavior. Mock: https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-export-2265.png
Liam Park: CSV exports currently drop pin info. Should include pin scope and version id.
Nina Torres: Agree. Suggest column names: Model, Version, Pinned (true/false), Pin Scope (model/row), Perf_p95.
Eli Jordan: Frontend note: we can add a metadata header row like `# pin_scope: model` to avoid breaking parsers.
Kara Gomez: A11y: CSV column names must be descriptive for screen readers. Avoid icons-only labels.
Maya Patel: Compact view tweak: move dense toggle next to Save View. Users miss it on the right.
Liam Park: Analytics to add: export_snapshot_started, export_includes_pin, save_view_created.
Nina Torres: Microcopy change: modal title -> "Export compare snapshot" and checkbox label "Include pin metadata (recommended)".
Eli Jordan: Pin affordance  move pin into leftmost column so it remains visible in dense rows. Make it a toggle button with `aria-pressed` and accessible label.
Kara Gomez: Badge accessibility: p95 warnings need color+icon. Provide aria-label e.g. "p95 increased 23% vs baseline" and ensure 3:1 contrast.
design-bot: Creating ticket RD-INF-4710 with owners.
Maya Patel: Action list: Liam analytics (Tue), Nina copy + modal (Mon), Eli move pin + PR (Wed), Kara a11y pass (Thu). Re-share when PRs up. :+1:
